condition: Wrist fracture, fracture clinic follow-up on warfarin

patient_persona.description: Abdul Rahim bin Othman, 66, male, owns a small bakery in Muar, Johor, still kneads dough and carries flour sacks; atrial fibrillation on warfarin. Fracture clinic, day six after a fall on wet steps. Hearty, loud voice, Johor Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Sarah Tan Hui Wen, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, orthopaedic medical officer at a Muar hospital. Brisk, warm; English-leaning, mixes Malay freely.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik Rahim, how's the tangan? Sakit lagi dalam simen ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sakit tu dah kurang sikit, doktor. Tapi jari-jari ni swollen, bengkak, cincin pun tak boleh tanggal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cuba gerakkan jari, buka tutup... boleh. Jari rasa kebas atau cucuk-cucuk?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kebas sikit waktu malam. Bila angkat tangan atas bantal, OK sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good, teruskan angkat tinggi. The swelling is expected, but kalau jari jadi sejuk, pucat, atau sakit makin teruk, terus datang emergency.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cincin tu kita potong hari ni, pak cik. Nanti jari makin bengkak, cincin jadi macam tali, block darah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alamak, cincin kahwin tu. Tak apalah, nyawa lagi penting.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Check X-ray hari ni, the fracture position still OK. Tulang tak lari. So no operation needed for now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Doktor, ubat warfarin saya macam mana? Ada lebam besar kat lengan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your INR today is 3.4, a bit high. Pak cik ada makan painkiller lain selain Panadol?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada... anak bagi ubat sapu yang panas tu, dengan satu biji painkiller kuning, tak ingat nama.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau ubat kuning tu jenis NSAID, dengan warfarin boleh berdarah. Jangan makan dulu, just Panadol 1 gram three times a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kedai roti saya pula, siapa nak uli tepung? Tangan kanan ni tangan kerja.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Enam minggu dalam simen, pak cik, lepas tu physio. No lifting flour sacks. Let your son handle it for now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susahlah, tapi takpa, saya jadi boss, duduk counter je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Datang balik minggu depan untuk X-ray, dan klinik warfarin check INR in three days.

patient_persona.description: Cheah Poh Lian, 81, female, widowed retired school clerk living alone in a two-storey house in George Town, Penang; day two after hip fixation. Knee osteoarthritis, took naproxen and aspirin on her own. Ward round. Frail, soft Penang Mandarin with Hokkien.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Hazwan bin Rosli, Malay man in his 30s, orthopaedic registrar at a Penang hospital. Patient, respectful; English-leaning, speaks simple Mandarin with elderly Chinese patients and switches to English for terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 谢阿嬷，good morning。今天感觉怎样？伤口痛吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor 早。痛是有一点，昨晚 nurse 给我打了针，睡得比较好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. 我是 Dr. Hazwan。你的 operation 很顺利，我们用了钢钉固定。今天 physio 会来叫你站起来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 今天就站？我还以为要躺一个月 bed rest。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不用躺那么久。越早站起来，越不会有 pneumonia 和血块。Physio 会扶你，你用 walking frame。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我试试看。Doctor，我在家都是一个人，楼上楼下，以后怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个我们会一起计划。Occupational therapist 会问你家里的情况。刚回去的时候，可能要先睡楼下。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我女儿在 KL，她说可以回来陪我两个礼拜。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那很好。还有，你之前在家吃 naproxen 和 aspirin，是谁开的？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有人开，是我自己在药房买的。膝盖痛就吃 naproxen，aspirin 是看电视说对心脏好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这两粒药一起吃，胃容易出血，你的 haemoglobin 也有点低。现在先停，痛就吃 paracetamol。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 知道了，以后不自己乱买药了，jadi pengajaran。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 另外，老人家跌一次就断骨，表示 bones 比较疏松。Before discharge 我们会开 osteoporosis 的药，还有 calcium 和 vitamin D。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 骨质疏松？Osteoporosis？难怪我这几年矮了一点。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，这就是原因之一。今天先跟 physio 站起来，我下午再来看你。

condition: Forearm fracture in a child, cast review

patient_persona.description: Puan Farah Wahida binti Mazlan, 34, female, civil servant in Putrajaya, speaking for her 8-year-old son Aqil, who fell from the monkey bars at school. Cast review at two weeks. Worried but composed, standard Malay with English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ong Jia Ying, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a paediatric orthopaedic clinic in Putrajaya. Gentle with children, clear with parents; English-leaning, speaks Malay with the family.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hai Aqil, macam mana tangan? Masih sakit tak dalam simen ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dia kata dah tak sakit sangat, doktor. Cuma gatal. Semalam saya nampak dia masukkan pembaris dalam simen nak garu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Oh, jangan masukkan apa-apa ya, Aqil. Skin can get cut, germs go in, then you get an infection bawah simen.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Habis tu macam mana nak hilangkan gatal? Ada cream ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh guna hair dryer, setting sejuk, tiup dalam simen. Atau ketuk-ketuk simen perlahan kat luar.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, OK. Simen ni pun dah ada bau sikit, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya tengok dan hidu sekejap... Bau biasa je, no pus, tak ada cecair keluar. Jari-jari pun colour OK, warm.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: X-ray hari ni, tulang dah mula bersambung, healing well. Posisi pun elok. Kids memang heal fast.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Berapa lama lagi kena pakai cast ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lagi dua minggu, total empat minggu. Lepas buka, tangan akan nampak kurus dan keras sikit, itu normal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dia nak pergi swimming class hari Sabtu, kawan-kawan dia semua pergi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak boleh berenang dengan simen ni, basah nanti lembik. Mandi pun balut dengan plastik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham. Ubat tahan sakit masih perlu tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau dia tak mengadu, tak perlu. Kalau sakit, paracetamol syrup 10ml, sampai empat kali sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Aqil, cakap terima kasih kat doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sama-sama. Lepas buka simen nanti, main monkey bar slow-slow dulu ya, Aqil.

condition: Ankle fracture after surgery, wound review

patient_persona.description: Ganesh a/l Selvaraj, 34, male, security guard at a factory in Klang who smokes 15 cigarettes a day; three weeks after ankle plating. Follow-up. Friendly, mumbling Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Faizah binti Rahman, Malay woman in her 40s, orthopaedic surgeon at a Klang hospital. Direct, dry humour; English-leaning, uses Malay casually.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Ganesh. Let me see the wound. Hmm, dah kering, stitches can come off today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Good, doctor. The skin very gatal already under the bandage.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itchy is a healing sign, tanda nak baik. Any pain in the calf, betis sakit, or kaki bengkak satu kaki?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Calf no pain. Only the ankle bengkak by the evening, after I sit long.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's normal for a few months. Angkat kaki bila duduk, ya. Still smoking?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo doctor... dah kurang, from one pack to ten a day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Better, but smoking slows bone healing and increases infection risk. The plate holds the bone, but the bone still has to join itself.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Serious ah? My friend also hisap rokok, his leg okay je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some people okay, some not. Nicotine patches from the klinik can help, kalau you nak cuba.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'll try the patch. Doctor, bila boleh jalan without the crutches?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Another three weeks non-weight bearing, then we'll X-ray. If the bone is healing, you can start putting weight with a boot.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My boss asking when I can come back. Night shift, a lot of walking, ronda keliling kilang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Six more weeks MC at least. I can write a surat for light duty, like duduk at the guardhouse.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: That one okay, I can sit and watch the CCTV.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Remember, sakit betis tiba-tiba or sesak nafas, go to emergency immediately. See you in three weeks.

condition: Metatarsal stress fracture in a runner

patient_persona.description: Chong Xin Yi, 23, female, junior auditor in Kuala Lumpur training for her first full marathon; low body weight, periods stopped for eight months. Results review after MRI. Soft-spoken, precise Malaysian Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ravindran a/l Maniam, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, sports medicine physician in Kuala Lumpur. Calm, non-judgemental; English with some basic Mandarin words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Xin Yi, your MRI shows a stress fracture in the second metatarsal, 脚中间的骨头。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Stress fracture？我没有跌倒啊，只是每天跑。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Exactly, it's from repeated loading. How many kilometres a week were you running? 一个礼拜几公里？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 最近差不多七十公里。Marathon 是下个月，我不想放弃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm sorry, but running on it now can turn a small crack into a full fracture. You need a boot and no running for six to eight weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 六个礼拜……那我这几个月的 training 都白费了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I know it's disappointing. There's another thing I want to ask gently. You mentioned your periods stopped. How long?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 八个月了。我以为是因为跑步，很多跑友都这样。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's common, but it's not normal. When the body doesn't get enough energy for the training, hormones drop and the bones get weaker.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我是有控制吃东西……因为跑友说 weight 轻一点会跑比较快。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for telling me honestly. I'd like you to see a sports dietitian, and we'll check your hormones and a bone density scan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要看 dietitian 吗？我不觉得我有问题。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's not about blame. 你很有 discipline, that's good. We just want that discipline to 保护你的骨头 too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好吧……那我可以做什么 exercise？不动我会很 anxious。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Swimming and cycling are fine if there's no pain. Next marathon, you'll run it stronger. Come back in four weeks.

condition: Steroid-induced osteoporosis after a vertebral fracture

patient_persona.description: Leung Wai Kit, 71, male, retired land surveyor in Petaling Jaya who gardens with heavy pots; polymyalgia rheumatica on prednisolone for 14 months; mother fractured her hip. First visit after a T12 compression fracture. Measured, precise Malaysian Mandarin with Cantonese colouring.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Amirah binti Zainal, Malay woman in her 40s, rheumatologist at a Petaling Jaya hospital. Methodical, kind; English-leaning, speaks functional Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 梁先生，你的 X-ray 看到 T12，就是背中间那一节，压扁了。那天搬花盆的时候痛起来，对吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，一个陶瓷花盆，大概十公斤。突然好像被人打了一拳。现在好很多了，but 还是有点酸。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 正常的骨头，搬十公斤不会断。你的 DEXA 是 minus 3.1，这是 osteoporosis。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我以为 osteoporosis 是女人才有的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 男人也会，特别是吃 prednisolone 很久的人。Long-term steroid 会让 bone density 流失很快。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我可以停 prednisolone 吗？我现在还吃 7.5mg。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不可以自己突然停，身体会出问题。我们会慢慢减，但是 PMR 也要控制。所以骨头要另外保护。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我开 alendronate 70mg，一个礼拜吃一次。早上起来空肚子，一大杯白开水吞下去。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 为什么那么多 rules？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吃了以后三十分钟不可以躺下，不能吃东西喝 kopi。不然药会刺激食道，也 absorb 不到。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，礼拜天早上吃，比较好记。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 另外每天 calcium 1000mg 加 vitamin D 800 unit。你有看牙医吗？有没有要拔牙？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 下个月要拔一颗牙，dentist 已经 book 了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那先去拔，伤口好了再开始 alendronate，比较 safe。以后搬花盆，蹲下去用脚力，don't bend your back。

patient_persona.description: Hasnah binti Mohd Yunus, 64, female, retired nurse in Seremban; early menopause at 44, low vitamin D. Results review. Knowledgeable, soft Negeri Sembilan Malay mixed with English medical terms.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kumaresan a/l Pillai, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, family medicine specialist at a Seremban health clinic. Warm, thorough; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Hasnah, result DEXA scan dah keluar. T-score kat tulang belakang minus 2.8. That's osteoporosis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya dah agak dah, doktor. Masa kerja wad dulu, ramai patient macam saya, especially yang dah menopause.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Vitamin D puan pun rendah, 32 nmol per litre. Puan selalu keluar kena matahari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jarang. Pakai tudung, baju lengan panjang, keluar pun naik kereta.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, kita bagi supplement. Vitamin D 1000 unit setiap hari, dengan calcium 1000mg.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebab early menopause umur 44, tulang puan lebih cepat nipis. We'll start alendronate 70mg once a week.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kawan saya kata ubat ni boleh buat tulang rahang rosak. Betul ke, doktor? Jaw bone tu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risiko tu sangat jarang, lebih kurang one in ten thousand. Yang penting, jaga gigi dan beritahu dentist puan makan ubat ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, gigi saya OK. Satu lagi, saya ada gastrik kadang-kadang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau gastrik teruk, alendronate boleh buat pedih. Kalau tak tahan, there's a yearly injection, zoledronic acid, masuk drip setahun sekali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya cuba yang oral dulu lah, lagi senang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selain ubat, jalan kaki pagi tiga puluh minit, dan periksa rumah, jangan ada karpet licin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bilik air rumah saya memang licin. Nanti suruh anak pasang pemegang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Kita ulang DEXA dalam dua tahun.

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Rukmani a/p Krishnan, 72, female, retired primary school headmistress in Butterworth, Penang; five years on alendronate, occasional heartburn. Follow-up. Crisp, formal Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Heng Soo Ling, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 50s, family medicine specialist in Butterworth. Thoughtful, precise; English-leaning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Rukmani, you've been on alendronate for five years now. Your repeat DEXA is minus 2.1, improved from minus 2.7.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: That's very good news. So boleh stop the medicine now or not?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's what I wanted to discuss. After five years, for someone with no fractures and a better score, we can consider a drug holiday.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Drug holiday? Meaning I stop completely?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop for two to three years, then recheck. The medicine stays in the bone and keeps working for a while.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But if I stop, the bone will become nipis again, right? My sister broke her hip at seventy-five.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a fair worry. With your family history, we'll recheck your DEXA in two years, and restart if it drops.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Also doctor, the heartburn. Every Monday after the tablet, dada rasa pedih sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Are you staying upright for thirty minutes after taking it? And drinking a full glass of water?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Honestly, sometimes I go back to bed after taking it. Monday morning, mengantuk sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That could be why. Lying down lets the tablet irritate the oesophagus. Another reason the holiday is good timing.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'm convinced. Calcium I continue ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, continue calcium and vitamin D daily. And keep your morning walks at the taman.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Every morning, doctor, with my neighbours. Dua pusingan je, then teh tarik kurang manis at the mamak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Perfect. See you in six months, and kalau ada new back pain or jatuh, see me earlier.

patient_persona.description: Wong Siew Fong, 78, female, retired dim sum restaurant cook in Ipoh with chronic kidney disease stage 4; on denosumab. Six-monthly injection visit, slightly overdue. Cheerful, loud Cantonese-coloured Malaysian Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nicholas Yap Kok Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, geriatrician at an Ipoh hospital. Warm, a little teasing; English-leaning, fluent Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 黄婆婆，你好。今天是来打 Prolia 的，对吗？上次是几时打的？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor 好！上次是二月，现在九月了，迟了一点。我去 Singapore 看孙子，lupa 了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 七个月，迟了一个月。这个针不可以迟太久，最多几个礼拜。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 为什么？Lambat sikit 有什么关系？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Prolia 停了或者迟了，骨头会很快流失，有时候会突然 multiple vertebral fractures。所以一定要 on time。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哎哟，这么严重。以后我叫我女儿在手机设提醒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好主意。你的肾功能不好，所以我们用 Prolia，不用那种吃的药。打之前要验 calcium。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 上个礼拜验了，nurse 说 normal。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，calcium 是 2.25，normal。Vitamin D 也 OK。那我们今天打，打在 lengan。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我每天有吃 calcium 一粒，可以继续吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，继续吃。如果嘴巴周围麻麻的，或者手脚抽筋，要马上告诉我们，可能是 calcium 太低。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 知道了。还有，我最近晚上起来小便，差点跌倒两次，jatuh 在走廊。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个很重要。晚上房间要开小夜灯，床边放一个便盆。起床先坐一分钟，才站起来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我叫女儿买夜灯。Doctor，next appointment 是几时？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 三月初，我已经写在 card 上了。不要再去新加坡 lupa 啰。

patient_persona.description: Lanyau anak Jimbun, 60, female, Iban retired rubber tapper in Sri Aman, Sarawak, low milk intake, two falls last year; referred after a pharmacy heel scan. First visit. Quiet, shy, Sarawak Malay with some Iban words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tiong Siew Ting, Sarawakian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Sri Aman health clinic. Gentle, encouraging; English-leaning, speaks Sarawak Malay with patients.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selamat pagi, Mak Lanyau. Farmasi kata tulang tumit mak rendah. Mak ada bawa kertas tu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, doktor. Diorang kata tulang kamek nipis, low bone density. Kamek takut, tak tahu apa maksudnya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, kita bincang pelan-pelan. Mesin kat farmasi tu screening je, belum tentu. Kita kena buat DEXA scan untuk confirm.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: DEXA tu sakit ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak sakit langsung, baring sepuluh minit je, like an X-ray. Kena pergi hospital Kuching, saya buat referral letter.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak pernah jatuh tahun ni? Any fall?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dua kali. Sekali kat tangga rumah panjang, sekali kat kebun getah. Tapi tak patah, cuma lebam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak ada pening, atau mata kabur waktu jatuh tu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mata memang kabur sikit, rabun. Tak ada cermin mata.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nanti kita refer check mata sekali. Jatuh dengan tulang nipis tu yang bahaya, boleh patah pinggul.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makan apa bagus untuk tulang, doktor? Kamek tak minum susu, perut tak tahan, lactose katanya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak minum susu tak apa. Makan ikan bilis, tauhu, sayur hijau, dan ikan kecil dengan tulang. Saya bagi calcium dengan vitamin D sekali sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Anak kamek bawa ke Kuching nanti.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Lepas dapat result DEXA, datang balik, we'll decide if you need other medicine.
